name: FND_DIAG_EXECUTION
description: Stores information on every invocation of a test.

columns.name: EXECUTION_ID
columns.description: Stores a unique GUID for every execution of a diagnostic test.

columns.name: RUN_ID
columns.description: Stores a GUID corresponding to the lauch of a Diagnostic Test Run. So, a RUN_ID may apply to an individual test, or to a group of tests. (A Diagnostic Test Run can be launched for any Tag Value ID, which corresponds to a taxonomy node.)

columns.name: PARENT_EXECUTION_ID
columns.description: This column makes a self-reference. One Execution ID can spawn one or more other Execution ID(s), which in turn can spawn yet other Execution ID's. Data in this column helps keep proper trail of nested spawning of Execution chains.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Overall Status of the Diagnostic test suite - Success (S), Failed (F), Running (R), Warning (W)

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Time when Diagnostic test suite was kicked off

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: Time when Diagnostic test suite stopped running

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Standard "who info" - when was the row last updated

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Standard "who info" - who last updated the row

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Standard "who info" - When row was created

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Standard "who info" - Who created the row

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Standard "who info" - login ID of the user who last updated the row?
